name: call-me
description: Call, text, and receive replies from the /call-me iOS app. Pair once (any session) and every Claude on this machine reaches the same phone.

user_number.title: Your /call-me number (optional)
user_number.description: The 10-digit number shown in the iPhone app. Leave blank and ask Claude to set up /call-me — it will walk you through it and remember the number in ~/.aiphone/config.json.
